Як сказати «надто холодно», «недостатньо: How to say “too cold”, “not tall enough”, “so funny” and “such a nice day”. Too means “more than is needed”, enough means “as much as is needed”, and so and such make a feeling stronger.

Too = «надто», і це завжди проблема: щос: Too means “more than is OK”, so something goes wrong. If you just mean “very” and it is a good thing, use very or so.
В українській «достатньо високий», тому: In Ukrainian the word order is “enough tall”, so learners say enough tall. In English enough comes after an adjective: tall enough. Before a noun it is the other way round: enough time.
Якщо після слова є іменник, потрібне suc: If a noun follows, use such (such a nice day). If there is only an adjective, use so (so nice). So a ... is never correct.
Шпаргалка: де що стоїть: Cheat sheet: where each word goes
Головне: дивимося, що стоїть після слова: The key is to look at what comes after the word. An adjective or a noun? Countable or not? Table: pattern, example, translation.
It’s so cold that we can’t swim.
He’s as fast as he needs to be.
We have the time we need.
I was very tired, and as a result I fell asleep.
Раунд 1. Too і enough: де що стоїть: Round 1. Too and enough: where they go
Too goes before the adjective: too hot. You can’t drink it, so it is “too”.
Enough після прикметника: old enough. En: Enough goes after the adjective: old enough. Enough old is wrong.
Перед іменником enough стоїть першим: en: Before a noun, enough comes first: enough chairs.
Too + прикметник: too big. Джинси завели: Too + adjective: too big. The jeans don’t fit, which is a problem.
Not + прикметник + enough: not fast enou: Not + adjective + enough: not fast enough.
Too late = надто пізно, щоб дзвонити. To: Too late to call. Too comes first.
Підняти не можу, тому too heavy. Enough: I can’t lift it, so too heavy. Enough would go after heavy, and much is not used before an adjective.
Прикметник + enough: old enough. Too і e: Adjective + enough: old enough. Too and enough never go together.
Enough before a noun: enough money.
Too + прикметник: too cold. Much перед п: Too + adjective: too cold. Much does not go before an adjective.
Не чути, тобто замало гучно: loud enough: I can’t hear it, so maybe it’s not loud enough. Too loud would mean the opposite.
People злічувані у множині: too many. To: People is a plural countable noun: too many. Too much is for uncountable nouns.
Salt незлічуване: too much salt. Суп нес: Salt is uncountable: too much salt. The soup tastes awful, so not enough.
Часу досить, тому enough time. Too без m: There is as much time as we need: enough time. Too can’t go straight before a noun.
Потрібен більший розмір, отже, черевики: I need a bigger size, so the shoes are too small.
Apps is a plural countable noun: too many apps.
He can’t reach it because he’s not tall enough. Too tall doesn’t explain the problem.
Too easy = надто легкий. Such перед прик: Too easy. Such is not used before an adjective without a noun.
